newsitem.title: CANADA: Silcorp ups Becker Milk offer.
newsitem.headline: Silcorp ups Becker Milk offer.

text.p: Silcorp Ltd said on Tuesday it sweetened its offer for Becker Milk Co Ltd to C$13.5 million in cash, a C$4 million promissory note and one million Silcorp shares.
Silcorp said in September it was offering to buy the variety store chain for C$12 million in cash, a C$4 million note and 950,000 Silcorp common shares.
The company said the final purchase price remains subject to further adjustments, including for working capital in Becker's operations on closing, now expected to take place by the end of November.
Silcorp also received notice from Canada's Bureau of Competition Policy that it could acquire Becker Milk.
